title: Hot Dog Sandwich, Reduced Fat, on Wheat Bread

content.title: About
content.content: The reduced‑fat hot dog sandwich is a lighter version of the classic hot dog, featuring a lean meat sausage placed between two slices of whole‑grain wheat bread. It contains less saturated fat while preserving the familiar taste and convenience.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Fat reduction is achieved by using chicken or turkey meat instead of traditional pork sausage.
Whole‑grain wheat bread adds extra fiber and micronutrients.
This sandwich is often offered in school and sports cafeterias as a healthier alternative.
In some markets it is marketed as a "lean hot dog" and sold in packs of 2–3 pieces.
The wheat bread may be enriched with flax or sunflower seeds for added nutrition.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Reduced saturated fat helps maintain healthy blood cholesterol levels.

items.title: Higher fiber content
items.content: Whole‑grain bread provides dietary fiber that supports regular digestion.

items.title: Good source of protein
items.content: Lean sausage delivers high‑quality protein needed for tissue repair.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Meat and whole‑grain bread supply B1, B2, and B6 vitamins, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: The product contains iron, zinc, and magnesium, which are essential for immunity and muscle function.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: People with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity should avoid this product.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some sausage formulations can be salty; those monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Certain versions may contain preservatives for longer shelf life; choose preservative‑free options if you are sensitive.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The sandwich is ready to eat straight from the package. It can be warmed in a microwave or on a grill, and topped with mustard, ketchup, or fresh vegetables to taste.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 0 °C–4 °C. The typical shelf life after opening is 5–7 days. Discard if an off‑odor or discoloration develops.
